TC-B-01.notes: Reference case. <button class='br-button primary'> element. bg-color rgb(19,81,180)=#1351b4 matches --color-primary-default. font-family Rawline present. border-radius 1680px (pill, valid). Accessible name 'Entrar' from visible text. No aria-label mismatch.

violations_found: Icon-only circle button has no accessible name: no aria-label, no visible text, icon has aria-hidden='true'
TC-B-02.notes: button[class='br-button circle'] contains only <i aria-hidden='true'> with no aria-label. Snapshot shows button[ref=e15] with no accessible name quoted. DS canonical example requires aria-label on all circle buttons. e-MAG 2.1, WCAG 4.1.2.

violations_found: Non-semantic <div> element used instead of <button>
TC-B-03.notes:
browser_evaluate confirmed: tagName=DIV, outerHTML='
Confirmar
'. Snapshot shows generic[ref=e19] (div). No semantic button role or element. e-MAG 1.1, 2.1.

violations_found: background-color rgb(19,82,180) = #1352b4 is not in DS hexLookup (closest valid token is #1351b4 = --color-primary-default)
TC-B-04.notes: Computed bg-color rgb(19,82,180): R=0x13, G=0x52, B=0xB4 -> #1352b4. DS token --color-primary-default is #1351b4 (G=0x51). Off by 1 in green channel — not a recognized DS token.

violations_found: font-family 'Arial, sans-serif' — Rawline is completely absent from the computed font stack
TC-B-05.notes: Computed fontFamily='Arial, sans-serif' on br-button element. DS token --font-family-base requires 'Rawline, Raleway, sans-serif'. Rawline fully absent.

TC-B-06.notes: Reference case (danger variant). bg-color rgb(229,34,7)=#e52207 maps to --red-vivid-50/--danger. font-family Rawline present. border-radius 1680px (pill, valid). Accessible name 'Excluir conta' from visible text.

violations_found: aria-label 'Cancelar' does not match visible text 'Confirmar' (normalized: 'cancelar' != 'confirmar')
TC-B-07.notes: button has aria-label='Cancelar' but textContent='Confirmar'. After normalize (trim+lowercase): 'cancelar' != 'confirmar'. Screen readers announce 'Cancelar' while sighted users see 'Confirmar'. WCAG 2.5.3.

violations_found: border-radius 6px is not in the DS token set (valid values: 0px, 4px, 8px, 16px, 500px+, 50%)
TC-B-08.notes: Computed borderRadius=6px on br-button element. DS surface rounder tokens: 4px (--surface-rounder-sm), 8px (--surface-rounder-md), 16px (--surface-rounder-lg), plus 0px, pill (>500px), circle (50%). 6px matches none.

TC-B-09.notes: Reference case (circle button with accessible name). aria-label='Pesquisar' present. Icon has aria-hidden='true'. font-family Rawline present. border-radius 50% (valid).

violations_found: Focus outline suppressed: .v-focus-a button when focused has outline:none and box-shadow:none, overriding DS gold focus ring
TC-B-10.notes: browser_evaluate: btn.focus() then getComputedStyle -> outline='rgb(255,255,255) none 2.67px', outlineStyle='none', boxShadow='none'. DS normally applies gold outline (#c2850c) via :focus-visible. Both indicators removed, making focused state visually indistinguishable. e-MAG 4.4, WCAG 2.4.7.

violations_found: <span role='button'> used instead of native <button> element
TC-B-11.notes: outerHTML: Confirmar. While role='button' provides semantics, lacks native button behavior: no Space-key activation without JS, not natively focusable, implicit type mismatch. DS component spec requires

violations_found: <a href='#'> element used for a button action ('Excluir arquivo') instead of <button>
TC-B-12.notes: outerHTML: Excluir arquivo. 'Excluir arquivo' is a destructive action, not navigation. elements are announced as 'links' by screen readers. href='#' confirms no real navigation target. DS requires

TC-B-13.notes: Reference case (correct button pair order). Snapshot shows 'Voltar' (secondary) [ref=e51] before 'Proxima etapa' (primary) [ref=e52] — correct DS order. All tokens valid: Rawline font, 1680px border-radius, correct bg-colors.

TC-F-01.notes: Reference case. 'Nome completo' and 'CPF' inputs have explicit text: nodes in snapshot confirming visible label association. CPF has format hint 'Formato: 000.000.000-00' before the field (e-MAG 6.5). Button order: 'Cancelar' (secondary) before 'Confirmar cadastro' (primary) — correct DS pattern. Border-color rgb(136,136,136)=#888 = --input-border-color ✓.

violations_found: Textbox has no accessible name — label 'Nome de usuário' is not programmatically associated
TC-F-02.notes: Snapshot shows text 'Nome de usuário' as a sibling text node but textbox[ref=e70] has no quoted accessible name (appears as bare 'textbox [ref=e70]'). Label visually present but not associated via label[for], aria-label, or aria-labelledby. e-MAG 6.2.

violations_found: Textbox accessible name 'E-mail' comes from placeholder only — no aria-labelledby, no aria-label, no visible <label> element
TC-F-03.notes: browser_evaluate: aria-labelledby=null, aria-label=null, placeholder='E-mail'. Snapshot shows no text: sibling node before textbox [ref=e76]. Accessible name is derived from placeholder attribute, which disappears on input and is not consistently announced. e-MAG 6.2, WCAG 1.3.1.

violations_found: Label text contains '*' indicating required field but input has no aria-required='true' or required attribute
TC-F-04.notes: Snapshot shows label 'Nome *' and textbox 'Nome *' [ref=e82]. No required or aria-required in accessibility tree. e-MAG 6.3 requires both visual AND programmatic indication — visual asterisk alone is insufficient.

violations_found: CPF input has no format hint visible before the field
TC-F-05.notes: Snapshot shows text: CPF + textbox 'CPF' [ref=e88] with no hint element between them. TC-F-01's CPF has an explicit generic node 'Formato: 000.000.000-00' before the input. CPF requires visible format instructions per e-MAG 6.5.

violations_found: Error paragraph present in DOM but textbox has no aria-describedby linking error message to input
TC-F-06.notes: browser_evaluate: aria-invalid='true' IS present on input, but aria-describedby=null. Snapshot shows paragraph 'CPF invalido. Verifique o numero digitado.' [ref=e95] in DOM. The error text is not programmatically linked to the offending field — AT cannot associate the message with the field. e-MAG 6.6, WCAG 3.3.1.

violations_found: Button order: primary 'Confirmar' appears before secondary 'Cancelar' in DOM order
TC-F-07.notes: Snapshot shows buttons: 'Confirmar' [ref=e103] then 'Cancelar' [ref=e104]. DS pattern requires secondary action before primary. Primary first increases risk of accidental confirmation.

violations_found: Select/combobox 'Estado' has no visible <label> element in the accessibility tree — accessible name from aria-label only
TC-F-08.notes: Snapshot shows combobox 'Estado' [ref=e109] with no preceding text: sibling node. All compliant labeled inputs show an explicit text: node. Combobox has accessible name 'Estado' but no visible <label> element. e-MAG 6.2.

violations_found: Checkbox group 'Canais de notificação' has no <fieldset>/<legend> or role='group' — group has no programmatically associated accessible name
TC-F-09.notes:
browser_evaluate confirmed: hasFieldset=false, hasLegend=false, hasGroupRole=false. Group label 'Canais de notificacao' is a plain

element with no programmatic association to the checkbox group. Without fieldset+legend or role=group with aria-labelledby/aria-label, AT cannot announce the group name when entering the group. e-MAG 6.2, WCAG 1.3.1.

violations_found: Two 'Salvar' buttons share the same accessible name but serve different functions in different sub-sections — AT users cannot distinguish them
TC-F-10.notes: Snapshot shows button 'Salvar' [ref=e131] in 'Perfil publico' sub-section and button 'Salvar' [ref=e136] in 'Configuracoes' sub-section, both inside TC-F-10. Same accessible name, different contexts and actions. Screen reader users cannot tell them apart. WCAG 2.4.6.

violations_found: Input has aria-labelledby='ghost-label-id' but the referenced ID does not exist in the DOM — accessible name silently absent (falls back to placeholder)
TC-F-11.notes: browser_evaluate: aria-labelledby='ghost-label-id', document.getElementById('ghost-label-id') returns null (targetExists=false). Accessible name 'Nome completo' is derived from placeholder fallback, not the aria-labelledby reference. This is a broken aria-labelledby, NOT a simple placeholder-only label. e-MAG 6.2, WCAG 1.3.1.

TC-F-12.notes: Reference case (heading-as-label pattern). Snapshot shows heading 'Endereco de entrega' [level=3, ref=e146] explicitly visible before textbox 'Endereco de entrega' [ref=e148]. Accessible name matches heading text, NOT the placeholder 'Digite o endereco completo'. Heading provides a visible programmatic label (aria-labelledby) — valid per e-MAG 6.2(c). Border-color rgb(136,136,136)=#888 = --input-border-color ✓.

violations_found: Form input border-color rgb(255,102,0) = #ff6600 is not in the DS hexLookup — off-brand color token violation
TC-F-13.notes: browser_evaluate: input border-color=rgb(255,102,0). Hex conversion: R=0xFF=255, G=0x66=102, B=0x00=0 -> #ff6600. Not present in DS hexLookup. DS --input-border-color = #888 (rgb(136,136,136)). Off-brand orange color applied to form input border. Label association and button order are correct (text: 'Nome completo' before textbox, single 'Salvar' button).
